text: Implemented shared sparse-support Gram preparation, immutable reference factors, response-independent Schur jets, one-RHS-per-component voxel jets, exact/counted readout and shared-factor workers. Independent dense laws pass 5/5 on JVM and JS including AR whitening. Frozen-seed B0 final batch: N300 dense V100k prepared 30.422s/19.063MiB, exact 48.198s/21.124MiB; fixed 3.358s, one-ref 12.155s (3.62x), complete 9.06x; N1200 dense V10k 31.136s/187.493MiB. PHRF-10 decision: keep deferred; documenting before full gates.
